name: dotmoose-tools
description: Run public DNS, mail, TLS, web, and network diagnostics.

interface.longDescription: Run 40 read-only DNS, domain, mail, TLS, HTTP, website, network, and Looking Glass tools without a DotMoose account. Diagnostic targets must resolve only to public addresses; private, loopback, link-local, and reserved destinations are rejected.
defaultPrompt: Check the TLS certificate for dotmoose.com.
Inspect SPF and DMARC for dotmoose.com.

positive.prompt: Check the TLS certificate for dotmoose.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns point-in-time certificate details and links to the matching DotMoose tool page.

positive.prompt: Check SPF and DMARC for dotmoose.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the published records and diagnostic findings without modifying DNS.

positive.description: Trace a public HTTP redirect chain.
positive.prompt: Show the HTTP redirect chain for https://dotmoose.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the observed public redirect chain and final response.

positive.prompt: Calculate the usable range and host capacity for 192.0.2.0/28.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns deterministic subnet boundaries and capacity without network access.

positive.description: Run a public Looking Glass probe.
positive.prompt: Ping 1.1.1.1 from the DotMoose Looking Glass.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a bounded point-in-time probe from the advertised network location.
